claims.claim: Uday Ruddarraju said OpenAI used its internal models to optimize inference on Nvidia GPUs for Astra Ultrafast.

claims.source_title: OpenAI says its own models optimised Astra Ultrafast's inference on Nvidia GPUs
claims.supporting_quote: "We used our internal models to optimize inference on NVIDIA GPUs, and NVIDIA's programmability helped us deliver the acceleration behind Astra Ultrafast," says Uday Ruddarraju, chief technology officer of compute at OpenAI.

claims.claim: Nvidia says Ultrafast offers up to 8x faster token generation than Astra Standard and is available now on Blackwell in the OpenAI API and to eligible ChatGPT Work and Codex users.

claims.source_title: OpenAI says its own models optimised Astra Ultrafast's inference on Nvidia GPUs

claims.claim: Nvidia's artwork shows a Standard run at 17.0 seconds against 6.4 seconds for Ultrafast.
claims.episode_span: 17.0 seconds for Standard against 6.4 seconds for Ultrafast
claims.source_title: OpenAI says its own models optimised Astra Ultrafast's inference on Nvidia GPUs
claims.supporting_quote: Nvidia's artwork for the post shows a Standard run at 17.0 seconds against 6.4 seconds for Ultrafast, which is not the 8x figure and comes with no description of the task.

claims.claim: Ultrafast costs $300 per million output tokens, six times the standard rate.

claims.supporting_quote: Price has already been set against it: Ultrafast costs $300 per million output tokens , six times the standard rate, so the speed is bought rather than handed over.
